questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘MAGNET’ is written as ‘HFTIJO’. How will ‘CULPRIT’ be written in that language?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd42e50b6fe489fe11ffa2f4537d72ce15bf14b7393924b474a0ac17ef7246ac.png] 

**1) Vowels are increased by + 5.**

**2) Position value of the consonant 3) Position value of the consonant > 10, Code will be - 5**

 

‘MAGNET’ is written as ‘HFTIJO’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2463b3db439a885513a69bb7dd1a8be3eb406dac64aab54334f5be07b3bf2cd0.png] 

Similarly,

‘CULPRIT’ will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac88b24458e7c6b3489ee26500a9ffa6e02cd46114eaf28078ac9a766032d296.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"XZGKMNO".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Vowels are increased by + 5. For Eg: A is coded as F which is +5 position from A. Similarly U is coded as Z which is +5 position from U.
 
• Position value of the consonant less than 10, Code will be the opposite letter . For Eg: G is coded as T which is the letter opposite to G in the alphabetical order. Similarly C is coded as X which is opposite to C in the alphabetical order.
 
• Position value of the consonant greater than 10, Code will be - 5 position from the letter. For Eg: M is coded as H, which is -5 positions away from M. Similarly P is coded as K, which is -5 position from P.
